notes: §1985:VII.2.12.4 GR2: "There are seven forms of the RERUN clause" and "The implementor must provide at least one of the specified forms of the RERUN clause."; each of forms a to g then says where "the rerun information is written" and what the form needs (an ON phrase naming implementor-name-1 for the RECORDS and CLOCK-UNITS forms, an ON phrase and a switch "defined in the SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph" for the condition-name-1 forms). Implemented at 85: the source side of all seven forms. rerunClause and rerunEvery parse them, VisitRerunClause is the edition arm (accepted at --std 85, COBOL0902 from 2002), and ScreenRerunClauses, called by BindIoControl, refuses a RECORDS or CLOCK-UNITS phrase with no ON phrase or with a file in it (COBOL6530), a condition-name-1 phrase with no ON phrase (COBOL6530) and a condition-name-1 that is no switch-status condition-name of SPECIAL-NAMES (COBOL1639); ResolveIoControlFile resolves file-name-2. Probed at 85: the seven legal forms compile and run, each refusal fires. Not implemented: the function of any form. BindIoControl drops each clause after the screen (its summary: "a null rerun facility is conforming"), no member of CodeGen or the runtime mentions the clause, and the generated program is the same with and without it, so no rerun information is written for any of the seven forms. The RERUN clause is not in the Hardware Dependent Language Element List (§1985:p.XVII-94), so §1985:I.1.5.2.2 applies whole: "An implementation must accept the syntax and provide the function for all Standard COBOL language elements", and §1985:p.XVII-88 item 15 repeats the duty in the implementor-defined list. The posture is an agent's determination (DEVLOG 599, docs/VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE.md row 7.15); docs/CONFORMANCE.md has no line for it and no owner decision records it, so it is not a documented non-support. The fix is one of two: record rerun information for at least one form (form d, the RECORDS phrase, is the one no reel device conditions), or an owner decision that declines the facility and documents it. Also not asked, and moot while no form records anything: forms a, b and g say the file the rerun information is written on "must be an output file"; a form a clause over a file the program opens only for INPUT compiles and runs. The witness is form a (RERUN EVERY END OF REEL OF an output file) and checks only that the program runs.

next.reason: 1985: "There are seven forms of the RERUN clause, based on the several conditions under which rerun points can be established."; 2023: "No 2023 clause carries the RERUN clause; no candidate covers rerun points or any RERUN form.". No 2023 clause holds the RERUN feature and no candidate covers rerun points, so 2023 lacks the RERUN clause.
